summary: Iteration 9 — Project Delivery workflow (NEW) tested end-to-end. All 8 new backend tests pass (list, industry filter, detail w/ cost calc, 404, lead POST success, 400 invalid template_id, 422 missing fields, plus a marketplace regression smoke). Frontend /projects page renders all 5 PMI phase cards, all 8 template cards, industry filter chips (fintech filter narrows to 2), modal opens with all data-testids present, lead form submit succeeds and shows success toast, both close-button and overlay click dismiss the modal, and header 'Projects' nav (data-testid=nav-projects) navigates to /projects. Landing hero trust bullets are the new 3 (Structured engagements / milestone-linked pricing / same-day payment) with no dual-party/8% platform fee/12-month exclusivity phrases in the hero region. However, the STATS bento and FAQ #1 on Landing still surface the removed contractual language (see marketing_gaps below) — flagging for main agent to decide.

marketing_gaps.issue: Still displays big-number stats: '12 · Months of exclusivity' and '8% · Platform fee'. Per marketing revision request these contractual/pricing terms should not appear on the website.
FAQ answer still reads: "Both sides sign a contract. Talent is bound by a 12-month exclusivity clause so no side-door hiring. Our platform fee is 8% (vs 20%)." — contradicts the marketing revision.
Testimonial quote by Marcus O. mentions "the contract, the hours, the exclusivity" — same theme.

action_items: Decide whether STATS bento (12/exclusivity, 8%/platform fee), FAQ #1 answer, and Marcus O. testimonial on Landing should be rewritten to match the new marketing tone — hero bullets already done, but these three spots still surface the terms.
No functional bugs to fix in Projects workflow — ship as-is.
critical_code_review_comments: Projects.jsx modal uses `absolute top-6 right-6` for close button but the parent modal container is not `relative`; the close X is still clickable/visible in practice but visually may drift depending on scroll. Minor.
Projects.jsx line 79-92 phase cards are inside md:grid-cols-5 — deliverables lists can be long; on tablet widths they cram. Consider md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-5.
Backend template detail cost math weights average by count (line 1733). Result is correct but the formula string is dense; add a brief comment for maintainers.
seed_data_creation: Two TEST_-prefixed docs inserted into db.project_leads via lead POST tests (one via pytest, one via UI test). Safe to leave — non-sensitive scoping requests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Projects page + endpoints fully green. Only outstanding item is the marketing-copy scrub on non-hero regions (STATS bento + FAQ + one testimonial) — verify those if main agent updates them. Regression on prior iterations was not re-executed here; existing pytest modules /app/backend/tests/test_iteration{5..8}*.py can be re-run if broader regression is needed.
